title: Iɣbula d tebibliyugrafit
lede: Imeskaren iqdimen i ɣ-id-iqqaren ildi n Qarṭaǧ — qrib akk d igrikiyen neɣ d iṛumaniyen — d idlisen imaynuten n yimesnezruyen akked yimesneɣzuyen i fell-asen yebna usmel-agi.
heroAlt: Texxamt n Qarṭaǧ deg usidag agdawan n Bardo, di Tunes
intros.ancient: Qarṭaǧ cwiṭ i d-teǧǧa s tira : nessen-itt s wacḥal seg yiɛdawen-is. Yal aɣbalu yettwabeggen akked wayen i d-yewwi d uxemmem-is.
intros.general: Ifiniqiyen, Lebḥer Ageraɣlan n zik akked imenɣan n Ṛuma : talast tamatut.
intros.carthage: Igzulen d tezrawin i yecban tamdint tapunit.
intros.art: Tibdarin n lmuɛarraḍat d idlisen ɣef tsenɛet tafiniqit d tpunit.
intros.archaeology: Iɣzuyen, imukan d uḥader : Qarṭaǧ, Kerkuan akked Tunisia n zik.
intros.further: Idlisen n tmusni, ungal n umezruy, tiwlafin d yidlisen n tkarṭat i wakken ad tkemmlem tɣuri.
wikiText: Usmel-agi yebna daɣen ɣef yimagraden « Carthage » akked « Civilisation carthaginoise » n Wikipedia s tefransist, i ɣef ttwabeddel wawal, nutni ssufuɣen-t s turagt CC BY-SA 4.0. Tibdarin bibliyugrafikiyin yellan agemma usan-d syen.
links.0.title: Amezruy n yimenyaf
links.0.text: Acuɣer iɣbula iqdimen ɣef Qarṭaǧ qrib akk d iṛumaniyen neɣ d igrikiyen.
links.1.title: Abdar n wussan
links.1.text: Seg users armi d uɣelli, wussan ixataren n Qarṭaǧ.
metaDesc: Iɣbula iqdimen (Polybe, Tite-Live, Appien, Diodore...) akked tbibliyugrafit tatrart ɣef Qarṭaǧ d idles apuni, s ufran d unadi.
